biocontainers.name: bioconductor-roseq
biocontainers.summary: A Rank Based Approach to Modeling Gene Expression

biotools.summary: ROSeq - A rank based approach to modeling gene expression with filtered and normalized read count matrix. ROSeq takes filtered and normalized read matrix and cell-annotation/condition as input and determines the differentially expressed genes between the contrasting groups of single cells. One of the input parameters is the number of cores to be used.
